title: Density at least one on the support inside B_rho(0) (Simon Ch. 4, 3.11, 4.9, 4.10(1))
statement: Let n >= 1, l >= 0, p > n, U open in R^(n+l), V a RectifiableVarifold n l U, H : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l), delta, rho real numbers with AllardHypotheses H p delta rho (rho > 0, V has generalized mean curvature H in U, theta >= 1 mu-a.e., 0 in spt V, B_rho(0) contained in U, mu(B_rho(0)) <= (1+delta) omega_n rho^n, (rho^(p-n) integral_{B_rho(0)} |H|^p dmu)^(1/p) <= delta). Then for every y in spt V with |y| < rho and every epsilon > 0 there is s_0 > 0 such that mu(B_s(y)) >= (1 - epsilon) omega_n s^n for all s in (0, s_0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ ball (0 : Amb n ℓ) ρ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) * (unitBallVolume n * s ^ n)) ≤ V.weight (closedBall y s)
